puzzle.hint: A clear proof or evidence that leaves no doubt.
puzzle.arabicVerse: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
puzzle.verse: 98:4 - Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided until after there had come to them clear evidence.
